prev_card.title: You found the Mona Lisa!
prev_card.html:
The photo was taken at the port of Le Havre. At 00:35 the police opened crate CR-017 there, next to the container. The Mona Lisa was inside, unharmed.

The phone wrote its model, the time and the position into the file. That is metadata: data about the photo, stored inside the photo. The sender never typed it.
